title: Student and pocket-money budgeting
publisher: Artha Kavach summary of public guidance (RBI / SEBI / IRDAI / Income Tax Dept) — pending manual verification
text: With a limited allowance or stipend, the aim is not to cut every fun expense but to know where money goes. Write down fixed costs first (rent or hostel, mess, transport, phone), then set a weekly cash limit for wants like food delivery, movies and shopping. Use one UPI app and review it once a week; small daily spends add up quickly. Keep a tiny 'buffer' of one or two weeks of costs in a separate account, and save even ₹200–500 a month to start the habit. Be careful with BNPL, pay-later and instant-loan apps: they make overspending easy and carry high fees. Side income — tutoring, freelancing, internships — can be saved first and spent after, and keep proof of income if it grows large enough to need tax filing.
summary_hinglish: Student budget mein pehle fixed kharche (hostel, mess, transport, phone) likho, phir wants ke liye weekly limit lagao. Ek UPI app use karo aur hafte mein ek baar review karo. ₹200-500 bhi mahine mein bachana shuru karo. BNPL aur instant loan apps se bacho.
summary_hi: विद्यार्थी बजट में पहले तय खर्च (हॉस्टल, मेस, यात्रा, फोन) लिखें, फिर शौक के खर्च के लिए साप्ताहिक सीमा रखें। एक UPI ऐप इस्तेमाल करें और हफ्ते में एक बार देखें। ₹200-500 भी हर महीने बचाना शुरू करें। BNPL और इंस्टेंट लोन ऐप से बचें।
